title: Declare which soft recipe fields may evolve under optimization
narrative: Hard nodes and trusted contracts are never silently rewritten by an optimizer; only allowlisted soft parameters (prompts, bounded rounds, reviewer counts) may evolve. Soft points already exist (`fangore_graph_template_soft_points`, `fangore_insp_soft_vs_hard`). Tracks MH-SR-03[^insp-sr-03].
implementation: `SoftPoint.evolvable` (default `False`) declares the evolution allowlist. `GraphTemplate.evolvable_soft_point_names()` lists it and `assert_evolution_allowed(changed)` refuses any edit outside it. `produce_critique_refine` marks `critique_prompt` and `max_rounds`; `independent_review` marks `reviewer_count`; every other catalog soft point stays hard.
validation: Harness `graph_recipes` op `soft_point_evolution_allowlist`. Hard expects allowlisted edits allowed, runner-kind and policy edits refused, and `verify_repair` having no evolvable points.
